crossRefs.note: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man…
For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door…
At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne…
In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
“I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your…
In all vineyards there will be wailing; for I will pass through the middle of you,” says Yahweh.
But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone…
Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will…
He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. And their king passes on…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
